name: How long does custom millwork installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does custom millwork installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom millwork installation varies significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. Small, straightforward projects, such as a single custom mantle, might take a few weeks from design to installation. Larger projects involving multiple rooms or intricate designs could extend to several months. Material sourcing, design revisions, and the fabrication schedule all play a role. Maine Results, Inc. will provide an estimated timeline during the initial planning phase, and clear communication throughout the project helps manage expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project scope and complexity, from weeks for small items to months for larger, intricate designs. Maine Results, Inc. provides timelines upfront.
